nodes.title: Night Shift Espresso, 340g
nodes.description: Our new house espresso. A washed Colombian from the Huila highlands blended with a natural Ethiopian Guji, roasted a touch past medium so it holds up in milk. Dark chocolate and stewed cherry up front, a long cocoa finish. Whole bean, 340g, in our matte kraft bag with the copper hill on the front. Roasted on Tuesdays in small batches, shipped the same week.

image.altText: Matte kraft coffee bag with a copper hill logo, labelled Night Shift Espresso
